# Dashboard Model

Interactive dashboard created for the topical workshop "Interactive Visualization, Dashboards, and Apps with R and Shiny" at ICPSR 2024 as a teaching assistant. This dashboard provides a summary of the data from the 2016 US elections.

## Course Details

- **Course**: Interactive Visualization, Dashboards, and Apps with R and Shiny
- **Instructor**: Yannick Dufresne
- **Dates**: July 29-31, 2024

[View the Dashboard](https://clessn.shinyapps.io/dashboard_model/)
